verdict.rationale: Kick's docs confirm a real double-entry ledger with a configurable Chart of Accounts that organizes a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet (kick-supp-coa, kick-supp-journal-entries), plus period locking to keep historical reports stable (kick-docs-14, kick-supp-locks) and a Tax Package export (kick-docs-9, kick-docs-20) — supporting on-demand, accurate P&L and Balance Sheet reporting for any period. However, no evidence in the pack explicitly documents a cash-flow statement being generated, so the third piece of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a cash-flow statement report, and independent/third-party verification of statement accuracy.
